title: TextAreaConfig
description: Serializable configuration for the RibbonUI text area atom.

id.description: Stable text area instance identifier; also the native textarea DOM id.

value.description: Controlled value owned by the host; empty when omitted.

placeholder.description: Placeholder shown when the value is empty.

name.description: Form field name for native form submission.

cols.description: Visible width in average character columns.

size.description: Explicit field density and target size.

resize.description: Native resize axis allowed for the field.

maxLength.description: Maximum number of characters accepted by the native textarea.

disabled.description: Whether native editing and focus participation are disabled.

readonly.description: Whether the value is readable but not editable.

required.description: Whether the field must be filled for native form submission.
